newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Sell San Miguel, says DMG.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Sell San Miguel, says DMG.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Securities Philippines Inc recommended a "sell" on beer and food firm San Miguel Corp saying its premium to the market was without foundation.
The research report dated July 18 and made available to Reuters on Wednesday said: "San Miguel's premium to market is without foundation, in our view... Sell above our fair value of 53 pesos."
The share was at 63 pesos on July 18. On Wednesday, it closed unchanged at 59.50 pesos.
Deutsche Morgan said the 14 percent cut in beer prices on July 1 revealed San Miguel's lack of pricing flexibility in the domestic market.
